title: SIPP care and work constraints vary modestly by region
source_unit: SIPP person record by reference month, stratified by Census region recode, using final person and Fay-BRR replicate weights

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own region and conditional universe

observations.method: Official region and child-care status flags/universes; WPFINWGT full estimate and 240 Fay-BRR replicate weights with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; time lost is conditional and imprecise.
observations.counterinterpretation: Region is place context, not provider capacity, employer practice, or a causal exposure.

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own region and conditional universe

observations.method: Same official-universe and Fay-BRR method as the Northeast subgroup.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; time lost is conditional and imprecise.
observations.counterinterpretation: The higher work-prevention estimate does not identify labor-market, child-care-supply, housing, or employer causes.

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own region and conditional universe

observations.method: Same official-universe and Fay-BRR method as the Northeast subgroup.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; time lost is conditional and less precise.
observations.counterinterpretation: A national regional label masks within-region income, tenure, race, disability, provider, and work differences.

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own region and conditional universe

observations.method: Same official-universe and Fay-BRR method as the Northeast subgroup.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; time lost is conditional and imprecise.
observations.counterinterpretation: The similar paid-care rate across regions does not mean similar prices, provider access, commute, work schedules, or unmet need.

related_sources.claim: Official region recode, child-care status flags, and universes.

boundary: This is a person-weighted, design-based regional comparison. It does not establish local provider capacity, housing or labor-market causation, household prevalence, recovery, trust, or political action.
